newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 96 real industrial output +6.8 pct (+9.2pct).
newsitem.headline: Czech 96 real industrial output +6.8 pct (+9.2pct).

text.p: Czech real definitive industrial output in December grew by 1.5 percent, year-on-year, putting output for 1996 up 6.8 percent, year-on-year, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Monday.
It added that average industrial monthly wages grew, in nominal terms, 21.1 percent in December compared with an 14.4 percent rise in November, year-on-year.
INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT DEC/96 NOV/96 JAN-DEC-96 DEC/95

NOTE. Preliminary estimates in brackets. The average nominal industrial wage in December was 10,461 crowns compared with 11,682 in November. The December index of real wages was up 11.5 percent, while the real wage index was 7.9 percent higher for the whole of 1996.
Wage results sample companies with 100 or more employees while output results include estimates of smaller firms as well.
